name: base
description: Everything a machine needs to be a usable machine: ZFS root and its bootloader, the memory guard a swapless host depends on, the login shell, the terminal emulator and the core command-line tools. A host taking only this is minimal but not crippled.
requiredReason: this is the ZFS root and its bootloader. Removing it does not make the machine smaller, it makes it unbootable

requiredPackages.fish: the login shell. users/tim-headless.nix sets shell = pkgs.fish, and a user whose shell does not exist cannot log in
requiredPackages.starship: fish sources `starship init fish` on every interactive start; without it each login errors
requiredPackages.fzf: fish sources `fzf --fish` on every interactive start
requiredPackages.zoxide: fish sources `zoxide init fish --cmd cd`, which is also what provides `cd`
requiredPackages.direnv: fish sources `direnv hook fish` on every interactive start
requiredPackages.atuin: fish sources `atuin init fish` on every interactive start
